nodes.text: The BSE Sensex and Nifty50 experienced a significant decline today, driven by fears over Q3 earnings, ongoing FII selloff, and concerns regarding the HMPV outbreak. Investors are reacting to these compounded issues, leading to widespread selling pressure in the stock market.
